messages:
Seema: quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A — can leadership clarify expected ship windows and migration steps for three areas we heard about: hosted API streaming & function-calling SLAs, console rollout controls (canary knobs/rollback), and Optimize automated suggestions for batching/quantization? TL;DR: when do teams expect these to land and what should we prepare? :wave:

Dmitri: short answers: API streaming SLA GA ~6 weeks (target mid-May). Rate-limit model changes will be opt-in beta next week, full rollout later once we finish org-level metrics. Console rollout controls — engineering PRs in flight, aiming for internal dogfood in ~3 weeks. Optimize heuristics are in staging now; GA end of quarter. I'll drop a short timeline after this thread.

Anya: to be concrete — the streaming SLA you mentioned, is that p95 token latency at 2k seq? and will any of this change per-token billing or just performance guarantees? :thinking_face:

Dmitri: yes — SLA is p95 per-token issuance ~300ms on Dedicated for sequences up to 2k. No change to billing units; this is a performance SLA. Optimize suggestions might change config (batching/quant) which affects cost; we'll surface expected savings per suggestion.

Mike: from infra side — rollout knobs will include `canary_percent`, `canary_duration_min`, and `auto_rollback_on_errors`. example config we plan to expose in the console/API:
```
{
  "canary_percent": 10,
  "canary_duration_min": 30,
  "auto_rollback_on_errors": true
}
```

Kevin: will that be console-first UI or API-only? SREs need a visual for fast ops checks.

Dmitri: console UI first (beta), then API endpoints. RBAC hooks will be in place so teams can restrict who flips canaries.

Anya: for Optimize staging — can teams opt into suggestions per-route? we want to test on non-critical routes before auto-applying in prod.

Dmitri: yes — opt-in per-route initially. we'll ship an "apply-suggestions" toggle and a report showing expected token savings + estimated quality risk so you can make informed decisions.

Seema: great. can you post a short doc with concrete dates + migration steps? also @deploy-bot can we schedule a reminder to dogfood the console beta in three weeks?

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: dogfood console-beta in 3 weeks (2026-04-12). :white_check_mark:

Mike: :thumbsup: i'll coordinate with SRE to book the dogfood window and share the checklist (load generator, synthetic prompts, rollback playbook).

Dmitri: added a short timeline + migration notes to the roadmap doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/optimize-console-api?ref=slack-thread — i'll update with benchmarks and the beta opt-in form by EOD.

Seema: thanks all — DM me to be added to the beta list. closing this thread but will pull in folks for follow-ups.
